meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以搜索你过去所有会话的记忆库:先用 search 拿到带 ID 的索引表,再用 timeline 看某条记录前后的上下文,最后只对选中的 ID 取完整详情。
howto.when: 当你问的是以往会话而不是当前对话时触发,比如「这个问题之前解决过吗」「上次是怎么处理的」等。

say.text: 上次我们是怎么解决登录问题的?
say.note: 先给出索引表,再按需取详情

say.text: 搜一下 my-project 里关于 authentication 的记录
say.note: 返回带 ID、时间和标题的索引表

say.text: 把 #11131 前后的记录按时间线列出来
say.note: 返回锚点前后各若干条记录

howto.what_en: Claude can search the memory database of your past sessions: it first runs a search to get an index table with IDs, then a timeline for context, then fetches full details only for the records you pick.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about previous sessions rather than the current chat, e.g. "did we already fix this?" or "how did we solve X last time?"

say_en.text: How did we fix the login issue last time?
say_en.note: Returns an index table first, details on demand

say_en.text: Search my-project for records about authentication
say_en.note: Returns an index table with IDs, times, titles
Returns items before and after the anchor
